products.name: KUDA SIRI 2 ENVELOPE SET
products.description: The Horse series 2 is a special stamp collection, a continuation of Malaysia’s longstanding appreciation for the many roles horses have played across culture, community and sport. This second instalment showcasing three significant facets of Malaysia’s horse-related heritage: Horseback Archery, Endurance Riding, and the Bajau Samah Horse, also known as the Paddy Pony (Kuda Padi), an iconic symbol deeply rooted in Sabah’s cultural landscape—timed perfectly with the Year of the Horse this year.
products.contents: This Product Includes: ● 10 FCS with free Leaflet Date of issue: 24.2.2026 Place of issue: Kuala Lumpur
